text: The owned test creates authenticationStepShown before clicking Continue and awaits it afterward. The accepted source clicks Continue before finding and waiting on the authentication form. The password helper then waits for a visible password control and its expected input event. This source comparison does not establish a production authentication fix or a general rule about the Gecko attribute-wait helper. No test ran.
title: The owned Exchange discovery wait reorder is absent from accepted source
